title: Foundation Plants 50,000 Trees in Western Ghats
excerpt: A major milestone in our reforestation project has been reached with the successful planting of 50,000 native saplings in the degraded zones of the Western Ghats.

title: New Veterinary Care Center Opens in Rural Region
excerpt: Satyasaksha Foundation has inaugurated a state-of-the-art veterinary facility to provide free and subsidised care for farm animals and strays.
